Download `Tiquet_1.8.3_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. Runs on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) and needs no administrator rights. Built and tested on a clean GitHub Windows machine, not on a developer's PC.

The installer is not code-signed yet: if Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info** and then **Run anyway**.

**Upgrading from 1.3 or later:** Tiquet offers this version by itself; press **Actualizar ahora** once. From this version on it updates itself. **From 1.0, 1.1 or 1.2:** run this installer once over the old version. The database upgrades itself on first start, after a copy of it is kept.

New in 1.8.3: **Tiquet updates itself, and everything can be corrected.**

- **No more reinstalling.** Tiquet looks for a new version every 15 minutes, downloads it in the background and installs it when the till is free: no sale on the screen and nobody touching it for two minutes. It opens again by itself, with the same person signed in. A sale in progress is never interrupted. **Ajustes > Datos y copias** can turn this off.
- **Charged the wrong way?** Right after the sale, or in **Hoy**, tap the right way of paying. It stays the same ticket, and it keeps who changed it and when. The totals and the till follow.
- **Edit a sale.** In **Hoy**, **Editar** puts a sale of today back on the main page to change items, quantities or prices. Charging it replaces the old sale: the new one has its own number, and the old one stays under **Borrados** as "Corregida en…".
- **Edit a recharge or an expense.** In **Hoy**, **Editar**: amount, what it was, how it was paid, the operator or supplier, the date.

Also in 1.8: everything on one main page with a switch for printing, big **Efectivo** and **Tarjeta** buttons, **Recarga** and **Gasto**, the day's totals always in view, **Hoy**, and delete a sale, a recharge, an expense or a whole day.
